analysis:
Two files changed. CHANGELOG.md (units 7e16eb3337db8652:12 and :13) is documentation only, and I saw no security-relevant behavior change or threat-model claim contradicted in it. coordinator/store/postgres.go (units 61776f7450202650:0 and :1) is the only code change. The debit path near line 2274 now runs debitBalance inside an explicit pgx transaction instead of a direct pool call. Before the commit it checks ctx.Err(), so a client-side timeout can no longer leave an autocommitted charge. A deferred Rollback uses a fresh 5s context, and the nested `cancel` shadows the outer one harmlessly. It returns the original error unchanged, so sentinel errors such as insufficient balance should be preserved.

This tightens A-009 (payment ledger) integrity by removing a timeout-then-late-commit window. Two residual points: (1) a lost COMMIT acknowledgement is an uncertain outcome, which the new code comment acknowledges; (2) the transaction is held slightly longer, which is a negligible pool-pressure change. I did not see debitBalance's executor interface or the callers' error handling. A later pass should check that callers do not treat a commit-uncertain error as a safe refund or retry, which could cause double charges or free serving. That is an unseen-caller coverage limit, not an observed regression. No new attack surface was found.
